Title: Introducing appLens for Web Apps in Azure App Service

Body.Content:
“Why was my web app down?” is a common question that usually follows with more questions than answers, for example: “Was it a cloud provider issue?” “Was it a deployment that I rolled out?” “Was it just an abnormal increase in traffic?”

This first level of the isolation process should not take hours. With the appLens tool for the Web Apps feature of Azure App Service, you can visualize various data points in a few seconds.

To learn more about it and try it out, please visit the App Service team blog.
